title: Scramble Drill Live Rotation
description: The coach deliberately creates a broken defensive possession and the team must scramble to find shooters and rebound position before the shot goes up.

content.objective: Recover from a broken defensive possession by scrambling to the open shooters and boxing out.
content.setup: A coach starts a possession already broken down — one defender out of position or late.
instructions: The offense attacks the broken coverage immediately, looking for the open shooter.
Defenders scramble and communicate to find the most dangerous open player first.
On any shot attempt, every defender locates a body to box out.
Reset with a different defender starting out of position each round.
coachingPoints: Communicate loudly the instant the scramble starts.
Take away the most dangerous shot first, not just the nearest player.
Box out even in a scramble — don't skip the rebound just because the possession was chaotic.
commonMistakes: Panicking and running at the ball instead of covering the most dangerous shooter.
Forgetting to box out because the possession felt disorganised.
Ball-watching instead of tracking both the ball and the assignment.
content.safety: Keep the scramble at a controlled, game-realistic intensity.
